name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1896: The path was built after five names the readers genuinely saw were discarded on the server and never reached him, and it had never been driven with a real held pile. Measured in a real page against the forty-one names his own sweep is holding: forty-one queued, forty-one rows each carrying its reason, nothing auto-accepted, and still nothing after three sync passes - which is the part that matters, because a defect needing a second triage to bite would hide from one. No defect found, and that is the result: this is where his last two set pieces are waiting, with the reason each is waiting attached.
